mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when real GDP growth declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when industrial production increases by more than 1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000, signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3% and nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over the last two months signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased construction activity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when housing starts increase by more than 5% over the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month, coupled with a decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.1%, signals a supportive monetary environment with controlled inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL decreases > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the federal funds rate decreases by more than 0.25% and the consumer price index decreases by more than 0.1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% over the last two months signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased consumer spending supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when real personal consumption expenditures increase by more than 1% over the last two months.
